title: cyclosorus hispidifolius
intro: Cyclosorus hispidifolius, commonly known as the Himalayan chain fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its various health benefits. The bioactive constituents present in Cyclosorus hispidifolius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
